UGBA 10.sentiment: Reviews cover several different module instructors and disagree widely. Some modules are called easy, engaging and useful, while others are described as boring, confusing or with unfairly built exams. Common advice is to attend lecture, do the readings, know the formulas, and prepare early.

UGBA 101A.sentiment: Students report a very demanding course with low exam averages, hard time-pressured exams that differ from practice problems, and little curve. Reviews are mostly negative about lectures and support, with a few saying the instruction is engaging and fair. Expect to study well beyond the lectures.

UGBA 101B.sentiment: Reviewers are strongly negative, saying lectures are confusing and do not prepare you for exams, which make up about 80% of the grade. Complaints include cold calling, mandatory 8 AM attendance, no practice exams and no makeups. A few say it is manageable with a positive mindset and good studying.

UGBA 102A.sentiment: Students describe a subject that should be easy but a course they found frustrating. Common complaints are boring or confusing lectures, multiple choice exams that differ from practice exams, and unhelpful support outside class. Many say to rely on the textbook and GSI, or take the course elsewhere.

UGBA 102B.sentiment: Students say lectures are dry and mostly slide reading, with mandatory participation and attendance, and a heavily weighted cumulative final. Exams are math heavy and can include tricky questions that differ from practice. Some find the instruction funny and fine, but many suggest choosing another section.
